summary: Pin the events a job or claim cites, so evidence survives the journal's 5000-event bound and a candidate reviewed an hour later can still be read

coordination.notes: Extends the established owners rather than adding a parallel one. The journal (aiEventJournal.ts) keeps its bound and its cursor unchanged - nothing here re-reads game text or opens a second capture path; the store copies out of the journal through the same readFrom query a consumer uses. JobStore gains an optional evidence pinner on its constructor, so every existing `new JobStore()` call site and test keeps working and this module has no opinion about where evidence lives. Deviation from the plan's pseudocode, recorded rather than silent: `pin(refs, citedBy)` holds its source on the store instead of taking the journal per call, because JobStore.create would otherwise need a journal reference it has no other use for. The source is structural (EvidenceSource), so the store can be fed a fixture without building a journal.
